evidence.detail: The class extends the cache-loader base with key type rs/A/a$a and value type rs/A/d. R19 identifies those exact types as AssetIconItemKey and AsyncBufferedImage.
R19 AssetIconManager constructs this loader exclusively for its first expiring cache and passes the manager instance into the loader constructor.
load(AssetIconItemKey) extracts the key's three exact values itemId, itemQuantity and size and delegates them to AssetIconManager's item-image creation path.
The sibling rs/A/c loader handles AssetIconSpriteKey instead, proving this class is specifically the item-icon cache loader.

candidates.note: Name follows exact typed cache-loader role inside AssetIconManager.

evidence.detail: The class extends the cache-loader base with key type rs/A/a$b and value type rs/A/d. R19 identifies those exact types as AssetIconSpriteKey and AsyncBufferedImage.
R19 AssetIconManager constructs this loader exclusively for its second expiring cache and passes the manager instance into the loader constructor.
load(AssetIconSpriteKey) extracts the key's exact sprite directory and size and delegates them to AssetIconManager's sprite-image creation path.
The sibling rs/A/b loader handles AssetIconItemKey instead, proving this class is specifically the sprite-icon cache loader.
